metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.7 · 1971 · Dirty Harry
metas.description: When a killer calling himself "Scorpio" menaces San Francisco, tough-as-nails Police Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned to track down the crazed psychopath.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.2 · 1973 · Magnum Force
metas.description: Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan pursues a conspiracy of vigilante cops, who are not above going beyond the law to kill San Francisco's undesirables.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.7 · 1976 · The Enforcer
metas.description: Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan reluctantly teams up with rookie Inspector Kate Moore to foil a terrorist organization made up of disgruntled Vietnam veterans.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.6 · 1983 · Sudden Impact
metas.description: When a woman exacts deadly revenge on the aggressors who raped her and her sister ten years earlier, Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned to the case.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.3 · 1988 · The Dead Pool
metas.description: Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan must stop a sick secret contest to murder various San Francisco celebrities, with himself being one of the targets.
